'''Charles Sonnenburg''' (forum and DeckTech handle '''Sonn'''; also published as '''Chuck Sonnenburg''')<ref name="enc2008">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132637/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia: Volunteer Information], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 August 2008)</ref> was an advocate of the [[Players Committee]], serving as [[Rules Advocate]] and later as [[Design Advocate]].

On 22 June 2007 the PC named [[Evan Fitzgerald]] to stand in for Sonnenburg during a sabbatical, mainly to finish the Advanced Rules document.<ref name="ref2007">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070927192625/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 27 September 2007; PC Announcements of 22 June and 12 July 2007)</ref> An announcement of 27 September 2012 described him as the PC's last Design Advocate before [[Mike Tomashewski]], who &ldquo;departed some time ago&rdquo;.<ref name="guard2012">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003453/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=346&catid=1&Itemid=117 The Changing Of The Guard], starwarsccg.org (posted 27 September 2012; Wayback, 21 February 2013)</ref>

== Card credits ==
Charles Sonnenburg is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of one card.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Block 2]]. The occasions named in the concept credits date from 2005. The cards print the name as "Chuck Sonnenburg".
One card in all (Concept: 1).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Chuck Sonnenburg|Chuck Sonnenburg]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
